text.text_excerpt: This place is my go-to whenever I am in Las Vegas, so it was real cool to go to its place of origin in New Orleans (I think? I'm not sure haha) . I love the variety of frozen daiquiris they have here, which you can combine flavors and get funky with. Flavors range from fruit flavors to more fun NOLA flavors like Hurricanes, and cups range from small to insanely big (enough to share with 2-3 people!). Prices are cheap too, so if you want a fun drink to sip on while walking up and down Bourbon Street, come here!

There are so many places on Bourbon street with great daiquiris, but this place by far imo exceeds them all! Great prices, i think i spend $10 for a 32 oz! They have plenty of alcohol in the drinks, but they taste amazing! Everyone in my group had a different flavor. We tried the bellini, mudslide, amaretto & pineapple, strawberry, and a punch flavor. All of them were great, but the bellini was definitely my favorite! The bartender was super helpful and patient, and we also had some shots of patron while we were there! YUUUMMM! Best part is you can take it to go!

I originally saw this place in Vegas, and immediately thought it was a tourist trap. When actually getting to see it in New Orleans, at first I didn't think I'd want to come here, but we did anyway because a frozen drink sounded wonderful in the humid Louisiana heat. Based on my experience, it's not bad at all! In fact, if you love frozen cocktails, you're going to have a hay day here... There are SO many flavors to choose from!! I tried the Bellini, which was a fruity drink infused with champagne. I loovvvved it. It's a fun place to stop in at while you're on Bourbon Street, and thanks to the laid back laws of the city, you can walk around outside with it!
